title: Forgetting delta
prompt: The starter moves x by 120 every frame instead of every second, so one second of frames moves 7200. Fix `_process` so it multiplies by delta; then 60 frames move 120.
hints: Without delta, the speed depends on how many frames run.

docs.name: func _process(delta):
docs.what: Godot calls this once per frame, about 60 times a second. delta is the frame time in seconds.
